messages:
anika: Woke to a small pager storm from model-serving: kv-cache jitter. Lots of microblips (~20-90s) across regions that still escalate. Need a short-term quieting plan + owner for follow-ups.
oscar: yep saw clusters of short spikes. Rule is model_serving.kv_miss_spike. It treats any >4x jump as page immediately.
tess: short-term idea: require 3m sustained increase to page, demote anything <3m to warning and emit a suppressed counter. Also add suppression_key=fingerprint(region,model) for 12m.
ben: +1. I'd also prefer a suppression label like suppress_until so we can override per-cluster via configmap.
oscar: sketch of rule change (pseudo):
```
alert: kv_miss_jitter
expr: increase(kv_miss_rate[3m]) > 4
for: 180s
labels:
  severity: page
  suppression_key: "{{ $labels.region }}:{{ $labels.model }}"
annotations:
  summary: "KV miss jitter (>4x)"
```
and a separate metric: kv_miss_jitter_suppressed_total{region,model}++ when demoted to warning.
anika: immediate actions: oscar to open PR with 3m/12m changes + suppressed metric; tess to create remediation ticket and add runbook paragraph about "microblip vs sustained"; ben to draft a per-cluster config override. Owners?
tess: I will own the remediation ticket and runbook. ETA: runbook paragraph by Tue EOD.
oscar: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/780 (includes unit tests and staging validation). Will push to staging after review.
alert-bot: Staging deploy: prometheus/rules updated by oscar at 1803456900.
ben: I'll prep the configmap override pattern and post a sample snippet in the ticket by Wed.
anika: scheduling a 30m sync Thurs 14:00 UTC to review suppressed counts and decide final thresholds. Can we also add a dashboard panel for kv_miss_jitter_suppressed_total?
tess: yes, adding dashboard task to ticket (ETA before Thurs sync).
oscar: plan to canary the staging change to two low-traffic clusters at 02:00 PT tomorrow and monitor for missed real incidents.
anika: perfect. after the sync, tess to close the remediation ticket with final owners and timeline.
oscar: monitoring tonight, will post if anything odd.
ben: thanks team. :thumbsup:
